name: MongoDB Injection - Type Confusion for Login Bypass
execution: intercept login request
modify request to send JSON payload for username and password
use type confusion in password field (e.g., "not equals to admin")
send modified request

decision_points.if: login form is present
decision_points.then: attempt login with default credentials

decision_points.if: default credentials fail
decision_points.then: analyze login parameters and identify potential for NoSQL injection

decision_points.if: web application is Node.js/Express
decision_points.then: attempt to send JSON payloads instead of form-encoded data

decision_points.if: JSON payload with type confusion in password field bypasses login
decision_points.then: confirm successful login

name: MongoDB Injection - Regex Password Brute-forcing
execution: write python script to iterate through characters
construct JSON payload with regex for password field (e.g., "starts with X$")
send payload via HTTP POST request
append successful characters to form the password
continue until full password is found

decision_points.if: login bypass achieved via MongoDB injection
decision_points.then: attempt to brute-force the actual password

decision_points.if: regex operator is supported for password field
decision_points.then: construct regex payload to match characters sequentially

decision_points.if: a character is confirmed to be part of the password
decision_points.then: append the character and continue brute-forcing the next character

name: Source Code Disclosure - XML External Entity (XXE) Injection
execution: identify XML upload endpoint
craft XXE payload to read local files (e.g., /etc/passwd)
upload crafted XML file
analyze response for leaked file content

decision_points.if: file upload functionality exists
decision_points.then: inspect file types accepted for upload

decision_points.if: XML files are accepted
decision_points.then: attempt XXE injection

decision_points.if: XXE payload successfully retrieves a file
decision_points.then: confirm XXE vulnerability and proceed with further exploitation

success_indicators: application error messages revealing internal paths

name: Code Execution - Node.js Deserialization Vulnerability
execution: identify usage of "node-serialize" library in source code
locate cookie handling in application logic
craft malicious cookie payload using deserialization
send crafted cookie via HTTP request
establish reverse shell connection

decision_points.if: source code reveals usage of "node-serialize"
decision_points.then: analyze how the library is used, especially with user-controlled input

decision_points.if: cookie is being serialized/deserialized with the vulnerable library
decision_points.then: craft a deserialization payload to achieve code execution

decision_points.if: reverse shell connection is established
decision_points.then: confirm code execution and proceed with post-exploitation

success_indicators: command execution on the target system

name: Privilege Escalation - Sudo without Password
execution: run 'sudo -l' to check sudo privileges
identify commands that can be run as root without a password
execute the privileged command to gain root access

decision_points.if: obtained a shell as a low-privileged user
decision_points.then: check for sudo privileges

decision_points.if: 'sudo -l' reveals commands runnable without a password
decision_points.then: execute those commands as root

success_indicators: successful execution of commands as root

name: Information Disclosure - Database Dump (MongoDB)
execution: locate database files on the target system
use 'mongodump' to dump database contents
extract credentials from dumped data

decision_points.if: identified a running MongoDB instance
decision_points.then: attempt to locate database files

decision_points.if: database files are accessible
decision_points.then: use mongodump to extract data

decision_points.if: credentials are found in the dumped data
decision_points.then: use credentials for further access or privilege escalation

success_indicators: retrieval of database contents, including credentials

name: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) - Authentication Bypass
execution: identify authenticated endpoints
remove authentication tokens/cookies from requests
send requests to previously authenticated endpoints
analyze responses for successful access

decision_points.if: an endpoint requires authentication
decision_points.then: attempt to access the endpoint without authentication credentials

decision_points.if: the endpoint remains accessible without authentication
decision_points.then: confirm IDOR vulnerability and exploit for unauthorized access

success_indicators: access to resources or functionality without proper authentication
